смеяться.en: I love it when my son is laughing.

смеяться.en: We laughed at his jokes the whole evening.

смочь.en: We couldn’t come to the lecture yesterday.

смочь.en: My dad can’t go to the cinema with me — he is working.

смочь.en: I couldn’t lift that box — it is too heavy.

смысл.en: It was the house of well educated old (in the sense of "previous") Russian intelligentsia.

смысл.en: She didn't see any point in starting a relationship with him.

смысл.ru: Он нашёл смысл своей жизни в детях.
смысл.en: He found the meaning of his life in his children.
